name: Swedish Meatballs
description: Classic Swedish meatballs made with ground beef, served in a rich gravy, and optionally served with rice, potatoes, or pasta.
recipeIngredient: Cooking oil or fat for frying

recipeInstructions.text: Combine beef, bread crumbs, milk, eggs, onions, salt, pepper, and nutmeg. Mix really well.
Shape mixture into 1-inch balls.
Heat fat in a skillet over medium heat. Cook meatballs, turning with a spoon until browned.
Remove cooked meatballs with a slotted spoon and place in a bowl. Repeat until all meatballs are cooked, adding more fat as needed.
Pour hot water into the skillet and stir to loosen browned particles.
Blend flour and cold water, then stir into the skillet. Cook until the gravy thickens.
Pour gravy over meatballs and cook for about 25 minutes.
Serve with rice, potatoes, or pasta.

_similar.name: Jelly Roll Style Meat Loaf
_similar.description: A creative meat loaf recipe shaped like a jelly roll, filled with mozzarella cheese and baked in a loaf pan.
recipeIngredient: ½ cup cracker crumbs or dry bread crumbs

recipeInstructions.text: Mix all ingredients except ground beef in a large bowl, using only 1 cup of mozzarella cheese.
Add ground beef and mix thoroughly with hands until just combined.
Shape the mixture into a 10x12 inch rectangle on waxed paper.
Sprinkle 2 cups of mozzarella cheese over the meat.
Roll up the mixture like a jelly roll using the waxed paper and press ends together to seal.
Place the foil-wrapped jelly roll in a meat loaf pan and bake in a 350°F oven for 1 hour.
Drain off fat and pour reserved tomato sauce on the roll.
Bake for an additional 15 minutes.
Let stand for 10 to 15 minutes before slicing.
Decorate with tomato slices and green parsley on a serving tray.

_similar.keywords: meat loaf, jelly roll, mozzarella cheese, baked

_similar.name: English Shepherd's Pie
_similar.description: A traditional shepherd's pie with ground beef, vegetables, and mashed potatoes.

recipeInstructions.text: Brown the ground beef briskly over high heat. Drain off excess fat.
Add the chopped onion and reduce heat. Stir-fry for 3 to 4 minutes until the meat is well browned.
Sprinkle the flour over the meat mixture and stir to coat evenly.
Gradually add water, stock cube, Worcestershire sauce, salt, pepper, bay leaf, and thyme. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 40 minutes until the gravy thickens.
Add the can of peas to the meat mixture.
Transfer the meat mixture to a casserole dish and cover with mashed potatoes.
Bake in a 400°F oven until the top is golden brown.

_similar.keywords: shepherd's pie, ground beef, mashed potatoes

_similar.name: Beef and Rice Casserole
_similar.description: A hearty casserole featuring ground beef, sautéed celery and onion, and cooked rice, all baked in a tomato soup sauce.

recipeInstructions.text: Sauté celery and onion in butter until soft and tender.
Place rice in a greased 1½ quart casserole dish.
Top the rice with the celery mixture.
Season the ground beef with salt and pepper, then cook in a skillet until browned.
Arrange the cooked beef on top of the celery mixture.
Combine the tomato soup with water and pour over the meat layer.
Bake in a preheated 325°F oven for ½ hour.

_similar.keywords: beef casserole, rice casserole, comfort food

_similar.name: Sweet & Sour Meatballs
_similar.description: A hearty meatball dish smothered in a rich sweet and sour pineapple sauce, baked to perfection.
recipeIngredient: For the sauce: ½ cup brown sugar, ½ cup vinegar, 19 oz pineapple tidbits (undrained), ½ tsp salt, 1 Tbsp cornstarch

recipeInstructions.text: Mix together ground beef, onion, cracker crumbs, garlic, pepper, egg, and milk. Chill until firm.
Shape into evenly sized meatballs and place on a greased broiler pan.
Broil to brown on all sides, watching carefully.
Place meatballs in a casserole dish.
To make the sauce, combine brown sugar, salt, and cornstarch. Gradually stir in vinegar and soya sauce. Add pineapple tidbits and bring to a boil until thickened and clear.
Pour the sauce over the meatballs and bake in the oven at 350°F for 1 hour.

_similar.keywords: sweet and sour meatballs, baked meatballs, pineapple sauce
